## Model Overview

#Life Cycle

1. Cooperate
2. Pursue:
--agents first calculate their perceived groupishness with each other agent based on last round's cooperations
--then they choose who to pursue based on that and association value
 



```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r packages}

library(dplyr)
library(igraph)
library(foreach)
library(doParallel)
library(magrittr)

```


#Parameters
```{r parameters}

#number of agents
popSize = 100

#number of pursuits agents can make
numPursuits = 3

#number of rounds
rounds = 500

#probability of cooperating with group member
probCoopGroup = 0.9

#probability of cooperating with nongroup member
probCoopNon = 0.1

#number of generations
generations = 5

#number of loops
modelLoops = 6

multiplier = 1.4

#strength of selection
selStrength = 10

#probability of a strat flipping
flipProb = 0

#prim combo abbreviations 
#list the prim combo abbreviations in order to append later
primCombos <- c("A",
"P",
"D",
"G",
"AP",
"AD",
"AG",
"PD",
"PG",
"DG",
"APD",
"APG",
"ADG",
"PDG",
"APDG",
"XX")

primComboDF <- data.frame("combo" =  primCombos,
                             "tot" = NA)

primComboDF$tot <- nchar(primComboDF$combo)

primComboDF$tot[primComboDF$combo == "XX"] <- 0

#we need popSize/5 of each prim tot
tots <- unlist(lapply(unique(primComboDF$tot), function(i) {
  sample(primComboDF$combo[primComboDF$tot == i], 
         popSize/5, 
         replace = TRUE)
}))

```

```{r functions}
#diff agent generate function that makes number of prims in strat equal in population
agentGenerate <- function(n){

  #agent IDs
  id <- c(1:n)

  #association value
  av <- round(abs(rnorm(n, mean = 50, sd = 10)), digits = 2)
  av <- av/100
  
  #strategy
  combo <- sample(tots, size = n, replace = F)

  #strats
  alliance <- NA
  generalization <- NA
  displacement <- NA
  defense <- NA

  payoff <- 0

  agentDF <- data.frame(id, av, alliance, generalization, displacement, defense, payoff, combo)
  
  #map each letter to its prim
  primMap <- c(
    alliance = "A",
    generalization = "G",
    displacement = "P",
    defense = "D"
  )
  
  #fill in binary prim cols based on letters in combo
  agentDF[names(primMap)] <-
    sapply(primMap, function(letter) {
      as.integer(grepl(letter, agentDF$combo))
    })

  return(agentDF)

}


#Association Matrix#
#make association mat so that there is noise in how AVs are perceived by others

makeAssociationMat <- function(agentsDF, sd){
  
  associationMat <- matrix(, nrow = popSize, ncol = popSize)
  
  for(a in 1:nrow(agentsDF)){
    
    associationMat[,a] <-  rnorm(popSize, mean = agentsDF$av[a], sd = sd)
    
  }
  
  diag(associationMat) <- NA
  
  return(associationMat)
  
}


#Reciprocity Function#
reciprocity <- function(agent, adjMat){
  
  #pull agent's column which represents their received pursuits
  received <- adjMat[,agent]
  
  #pull agent's row which represents their sent pursuits
  sent <- adjMat[agent,]
    
  #calculate proportions of pursuits which were received
  reciprocity_scores <- (received / (received + sent))
  
  #nullify their own reciprocity score
  reciprocity_scores[agent] <- NA
  
  return(reciprocity_scores)
  
}


#Bayes Rule#
posteriorGroup <- function(prior, probCoopGroup, probCoopNon, coop){
  
  if(coop == 1){
    
    num <- prior * probCoopGroup
    den <- num + (1-prior)*(probCoopNon)
    
  } else {
    
    num <- prior * (1-probCoopGroup)
    den <- num + (1-prior)*(1-probCoopNon)
    
  }
  
  posterior <- num/den
  
  return(posterior)
  
}


#Transitive Inference#

transUpdate <- function(agent, agentsDF, pursuitMatrix, cooperationMatrix, groupMat){
  
  #get the prims they use
  primStrat <- names(agentsDF)[3:6][agentsDF[agent,3:6] == 1]
  
  #pull the indices of the agents that the focal agent pursued
  pursuees <- which(pursuitMatrix[agent, ] == 1, arr.ind = T)   
  
  #vector of pursuees that focal agent cooperated with
  sentCoops <- pursuees[cooperationMatrix[agent, pursuees] == 1]
  
  #vector of pursuees that cooperated with focal agent 
  recCoops <- pursuees[cooperationMatrix[pursuees, agent] == 1]
  
  #basically we are gonna make a list of agents that A can "see" in accordance with their strat
  posUpdate <- c()
  negUpdate <- c()
  
  #Alliance#
  if("alliance" %in% primStrat){
    
    #get the agents that also cooperated with agent's sent cooperations
    posUpdate <- c(posUpdate,unname(which(cooperationMatrix[,sentCoops, drop = FALSE] == 1, arr.ind = T)[,"row"]))
    
    #get the agents that did not cooperate with agent's sent cooperations
    negUpdate <- c(negUpdate,unname(which(cooperationMatrix[,sentCoops, drop = FALSE] == 0, arr.ind = T)[,"row"]))
    
  }
  
  #Displacement#
  if("displacement" %in% primStrat){
    
    #get the agents that agent's sent cooperations cooperated with 
    posUpdate <- c(posUpdate,unname(which(cooperationMatrix[sentCoops, , drop = FALSE] == 1, arr.ind = T)[,"col"]))
    
    #get the agents that agent's sent cooperations did not cooperate with 
    negUpdate <- c(negUpdate,unname(which(cooperationMatrix[sentCoops, , drop = FALSE] == 0, arr.ind = T)[,"col"]))
    
  } 
  
  #Defense#  
  if("defense" %in% primStrat){
    
    #get the agents that cooperated with agent's received cooperators 
    posUpdate <- c(posUpdate,unname(which(cooperationMatrix[, recCoops, drop = F] == 1, arr.ind = T)[,"row"]))
    
    #get the agents that did not cooperate with agent's received cooperators 
    negUpdate <- c(negUpdate,unname(which(cooperationMatrix[, recCoops, drop = F] == 0, arr.ind = T)[,"row"]))
    
  }
    
  #Generalization#
  if("generalization" %in% primStrat){
    
    #get the agents that the agent's received cooperators cooperated with 
    posUpdate <- c(posUpdate,unname(which(cooperationMatrix[recCoops, ,drop = F] == 1, arr.ind = T)[,"col"]))
    
    #get the agents that the agent's received cooperators did not cooperate with 
    negUpdate <- c(negUpdate,unname(which(cooperationMatrix[recCoops, ,drop = F] == 0, arr.ind = T)[,"col"]))
    
  }
  
  #remove any transitive inferences that involve self
  posUpdate <- posUpdate[posUpdate != agent]
  negUpdate <- negUpdate[negUpdate != agent]
  
  #Go through each one and update groupishness
  for(i in 1:length(posUpdate)) {
    
    #pull agent's name
    agentName <- posUpdate[i]
    
    #get prior groupishness between A and i
    prior <- groupMat[agent, agentName]
    
    #update their groupishness based on this transitive inference
    posterior <- posteriorGroup(prior, probCoopGroup, probCoopNon, 1)
    
    #update groupish mat with new likelihood
    groupMat[agent, agentName] <- posterior
    
  }
  
  #Go through each one and update groupishness
  for(i in 1:length(negUpdate)) {
    
    #pull t's name
    agentName <- negUpdate[i]
    
    #get prior groupishness between A and i
    prior <- groupMat[agent, agentName]
    
    #update their groupishness based on this transitive inference
    posterior <- posteriorGroup(prior, probCoopGroup, probCoopNon, 0)
    
    #update groupish mat with new likelihood
    groupMat[agent, agentName] <- posterior
    
  }
  
  return(groupMat)
  
}


#Contributions#

payoff <- function(gameMatrix, gamers, agentDF){
  
  #start the sum
  contributionTot <- 0
  
  #for each agent...
  for(agent in gamers){
    
    #their max contribution is their association value
    maxContribution <- agentDF$av[row.names(agentDF) == agent] * 100
    
    #get the percent of the AV they will contribute, which is proportional to number of recip ties within group
    proportionTied <- if (nrow(gameMatrix) > 1) sum(gameMatrix[as.character(agent), ])/(nrow(gameMatrix)-1) else 0
    
    #calculate their contribution 
    contribution <- maxContribution * proportionTied
    
    #add their total contribution to those of the other agents
    contributionTot <- contributionTot + contribution
    
    #add their noncontributed pay to their corresponding slot in payoff vector (what they keep)
    agentDF$payoff[as.numeric(agent)] <- agentDF$payoff[as.numeric(agent)] + (maxContribution - contribution)
    
  }
  
  contributionTot <- contributionTot * multiplier
  
  #divide the pooled contributions by the number of agents in the group
  basePay <- contributionTot/nrow(gameMatrix)
  
  agentDF$payoff[as.numeric(gamers)] <- agentDF$payoff[as.numeric(gamers)] + basePay
  
  #return the payoff vector
  return(agentDF)
  
}

#Reproduction#

reproduce <- function(agentDF, selStrength, n){
  
  #rescale payoffs to be between 0-1
  agentDF$payoff <- agentDF$payoff - min(agentDF$payoff)
  agentDF$payoff <- agentDF$payoff/max(agentDF$payoff)
  
  #add constant to prob weight to fix strength of selection
  agentDF$payoff <- agentDF$payoff + (1/selStrength) #the bigger the decimal, the larger the diff in probability
  
  #generate random offspring
  offspringDF <- agentDF[sample(1:nrow(agentDF), n, replace = T, prob = agentDF$payoff),] #the bigger the decimal, the larger the diff
  
  #Reset IDs
  row.names(offspringDF) <- 1:n
  
  offspringDF$id <- 1:n
  
  #Reset payoff vec
  offspringDF$payoff <- 0
  
  #Mutation:
  
  #for each agent...
  for (a in 1:nrow(offspringDF)) {
    
    #change their association value to be within certain SD of original parent AV
    association_value <- rnorm(1, mean = offspringDF$av[a], sd = .01)
    
    #don't let association value get above 1
    association_value <- ifelse(association_value > 1, 1 - (association_value - 1), association_value)
    
    #don't let association value get below 0
    association_value <- ifelse(association_value < 0, 0 + abs(association_value), association_value)
    
    #assign the new mutated association value
    offspringDF$av[a] <- association_value
    
    #flip each trait or nah and replace into corresponding cells
 #   offspringDF[a, 3:6] <- (offspringDF[a, 3:6] + rbinom(4, 1, flipProb)) %% 2
    
   }
  
  return(offspringDF)
  
}






```

#Life Cycle
```{r lifeCycle} 

start.time <- Sys.time()

#generate starting agents for each loop
agentDFs <- lapply(1:modelLoops, function(x) agentGenerate(popSize))

#set up parallel processing
cores <- detectCores() - 6
cl <- makeCluster(cores)
registerDoParallel(cl)
clusterExport(cl, varlist = ls(envir = .GlobalEnv))
clusterEvalQ(cl, {
  library(dplyr)
  library(igraph)
  library(tidyr)
})

results <- foreach(m = 1:length(agentDFs), .combine = rbind) %dopar% {

  resultsDF <- data.frame(
    "loop" = rep(m),
    "generation" = rep(0:generations, each = length(primCombos)),
    "combo" = rep(primCombos),
    "amount" = NA
  
  )
  
#birth the agents
agents <- agentDFs[[m]]

counts <- agents %>% count(combo)

resultsDF$amount[resultsDF$generation == 0] <- counts$n[match(resultsDF$combo[resultsDF$generation == 0], counts$combo)]

g <- 1
converged <- FALSE
  

# GENERATION #

while (g <= generations & !converged) {
    
    #generate association mat so agents see each other's av a bit differently
    associationMat <- makeAssociationMat(agents, 0.10)
    
    #matrix that holds each agent's perceived groupishness with each other agent
    groupishMat <- matrix(numPursuits / popSize, nrow = popSize, ncol = popSize)
    diag(groupishMat) <- NA
  
    #pursuit matrix list of noncumulative interactions
    pursuitMatPrev <- matrix(0, nrow = popSize, ncol = popSize)
    diag(pursuitMatPrev) <- NA
    
    #matrix that holds cooperations to be backreferenced for previous rounds
    coopMatPrev <- matrix(0, nrow = popSize, ncol = popSize)
    diag(coopMatPrev) <- NA

    
    # ROUNDS #
    
    for (r in 2:rounds) {
      
      #make the empty new pursuit matrix
      pursuitMat <- matrix(0, nrow = popSize, ncol = popSize)
      diag(pursuitMat) <- NA
      
      coopMat <- matrix(0, nrow = popSize, ncol = popSize)
      diag(coopMat) <- NA
      
      # PURSUE # 
      
      #only update groupishness for rounds after 2 when cooperation actually occurs
      if (r > 2) {
        
        #calculate groupishness based on last round's cooperations
      
        #bayesian update when there was a cooperation
        num1 <- groupishMat * probCoopGroup
        den1 <- num1 + (1 - groupishMat) * probCoopNon
        
        #update when there was not a cooperation
        num0 <- groupishMat * (1 - probCoopGroup)
        den0 <- num0 + (1 - groupishMat) * (1 - probCoopNon)
        
        #update groupishmat
        groupishMat <- ifelse(t(coopMatPrev) == 1, num1 / den1, num0 / den0)
        
      }
      
      #each agent chooses k other agents to pursue
      for (a in 1:popSize) {
    
        #pull others' groupishness values
        groupVals <- groupishMat[a, ]
        
        #pull others' association values from the perspective of a
        assocVals <- associationMat[a, ]
        
        #calculate the pursuit scores by combining association and reciprocity
        pursuitScores <- assocVals * groupVals
        
        #nullify their own
        pursuitScores[a] <- NA
        
        #order from highest to lowest scores
        pursuit_indices <- order(-pursuitScores)[1:numPursuits]
        
        #add 1 to their pursuits in the pursuit matrix
        pursuitMat[a, pursuit_indices] <- 1
        
      }
      
      # TRANSITIVE INFERENCES #
      
      #only for rounds after 2
      if (r > 2) {
        
        for (a in 1:popSize) {
          
          #update the groupishness of their third party relationships based in accordance with their prim strats
          groupishMat <- transUpdate(a, agents, pursuitMatPrev, coopMatPrev, groupishMat)
          
        }
      }
      
      # COOPERATE #
      
      #convert pursuit mat into the coop probabilities
      coopProbs <- pursuitMat
      coopProbs <- ifelse(coopProbs == 0, probCoopNon, probCoopGroup)
      
      #now agents decide whether to cooperate with each other agent
      coopMat <- matrix(rbinom(popSize^2, 1, coopProbs), nrow = popSize)
      diag(coopMat) <- NA

      #make that the new last coop to be referenced in next round
      coopMatPrev <- coopMat
      
  
      # GAME #
      
      #get matrix of only reciprocated pursuits
      friendsMatrix <- pursuitMat * t(pursuitMat)
      diag(friendsMatrix) <- 0
      
      for (i in sample(1:popSize)) {
        
        #randomly pick one agent to play game
        gamer <- i
        
        #pull indices of agents' reciprocated ties
        gamerGroup <- which(friendsMatrix[gamer, ] == 1)
        
        #add the gamer to the group indices
        gamerGroup <- c(gamerGroup, gamer)
        
        #subset the friends matrix to include only those in group
        gamersMat <- friendsMatrix[gamerGroup, gamerGroup, drop = F]
        
        #change the names back to original indices
        rownames(gamersMat) <- gamerGroup
        colnames(gamersMat) <- gamerGroup
        
        #Agents decide whether to play a PG game proportional to number of reciprocated ties in group
        #Game happens only if all agents agree
        if (nrow(gamersMat) == (numPursuits + 1) &
            prod(rbinom(
              nrow(gamersMat),
              1,
              rowSums(gamersMat, na.rm = T) / nrow(gamersMat)
            )) == 1) {
          
          #calculate the payoff each agent will receive
          agents <- payoff(gamersMat, gamerGroup, agents)
          
        }
        
      }
      
      pursuitMatPrev <- pursuitMat
      
    } #round
    
    
    # REPRODUCE #
    agents <- reproduce(agents, selStrength, popSize)
    
    
    # SAVE DATA #
    
    #count number of agents with each combo
    counts <- agents %>% count(combo)

    # join to primCombos so missing combos get 0
    allCounts <- data.frame(combo = primCombos) %>%
      left_join(counts, by = "combo") %>%
      mutate(n = ifelse(is.na(n), 0, n))
    
    #put it in results df
    resultsDF$amount[resultsDF$generation == g] <- allCounts$n[match(resultsDF$combo[resultsDF$generation == g], allCounts$combo)]
    
    if (max(agents %>% count(combo) %>% pull(n)) == popSize) {
      converged <- TRUE
      cat("converged at generation", g, "\n")
      
    } 
    
    g <- g + 1
    
} #gen

  resultsDF
}

stopCluster(cl)

end.time <- Sys.time()

```

```{r}

results <- read.csv("G:/My Drive/groupFormationResults/groupFormationrealRes_mar_11.csv")
results <- results[-c(1)]

results$totPrims <- nchar(results$combo)
results$totPrims[results$combo == "XX"] <- 0

#analysis mean across loops
analysis <- results %>%
  group_by(totPrims, generation, loop) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(amount, na.rm = T), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(totPrims, generation) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(total, na.rm = T), .groups = "drop"
           )
#plot 
ggplot(analysis, aes(x = generation,  
                     y = mean,
                     color = as.factor(totPrims))) +
  labs(x = "generation",
       y = "% of agents",
       title = "population of agents over time by number of prims they use",
       subtitle = "pursuitAmount = 4, rounds = 500",
       color = "# of prims used") +
  geom_line()

#analysis not mean across groups
analysis2 <- results %>%
  group_by(totPrims, generation, loop) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(amount, na.rm = T), .groups = "drop") 

#plot
ggplot(analysis2, aes(x = generation,  
                     y = total,
                     color = as.factor(totPrims),
                     group = interaction(totPrims, loop))) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(x = "generation", y = "number of agents")+
  theme_minimal()
      
#analysis by prim combo 
analysis3 <- results %>%
  group_by(combo, generation) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(amount, na.rm = T), .groups = "drop"
           )
#plot mean across groups
ggplot(analysis3, aes(x = generation,  
                     y = mean,
                     color = combo)) +
  labs(x = "generation",
       y = "% of agents",
       title = "population of agents over time by number of prims they use",
       subtitle = "pursuitAmount = 4, rounds = 500",
       color = "# of prims used") +
  geom_line()
```
